title: UI Core Components
summary: This module provides fundamental UI components for the application, including various status displays, layout structures, and reusable elements for user interaction and feedback.

nodes.label: User Login Display
nodes.title: User Login Interface
nodes.description: Presents a user interface for cloud model authentication, handling sign-in actions and managing authentication state based on user interaction and system focus events.

nodes.label: Stale Model Notification
nodes.title: Model Update Prompt
nodes.description: Notifies the user when a newer version of a model is available and provides an action to update the model, integrating with message sending and streaming status.

nodes.label: Upgrade Prompt Display
nodes.title: Feature Upgrade Notification
nodes.description: Shows messages related to feature upgrades or usage limits, offering an action button to direct users to an upgrade link.

nodes.label: Download Progress Indicator
nodes.title: File Download Progress
nodes.description: Displays the progress of a file download, showing completed bytes, total bytes, and a percentage, along with a visual progress bar.

nodes.label: Image Thumbnail Renderer
nodes.title: Image Preview Component
nodes.description: Generates and displays a thumbnail for an image file, converting raw image data (Uint8Array, Array, base64 string) into a Blob URL for rendering, with error handling.

nodes.label: Application Sidebar Layout
nodes.title: Main Application Layout
nodes.description: Provides the main layout structure for the application, including a collapsible sidebar and the main content area, adapting to operating system specifics.

nodes.label: Generic Message Display
nodes.title: Reusable Message & Action Display
nodes.description: A versatile UI component for displaying messages, status updates, or errors, optionally including a customizable action button for user interaction (e.g., sign-in, upgrade).

nodes.label: User Authentication Hook
nodes.title: User Auth Hook
nodes.description: A custom React hook (`useUser`) providing user authentication status, functions to initiate sign-in, and refresh user data.

nodes.label: Chat Interaction Hooks
nodes.title: Chat Messaging Hooks
nodes.description: Custom React hooks (`useSendMessage`, `useIsStreaming`) for sending chat messages and monitoring the streaming status of responses.

groups.label: Status & Alerts
groups.title: User Status and Alert Displays
groups.description: Components responsible for informing the user about various states, such as login requirements, model updates, upgrade prompts, and download progress.

groups.label: Layout Management
groups.title: Application Layout Structure
groups.description: Manages the overall structural arrangement of the user interface, including sidebars and main content areas.

groups.label: Media & Generic Displays
groups.title: Media and Reusable Display Components
groups.description: Components for rendering specific media types like image thumbnails and a generic, reusable component for displaying messages and actions.
